media.title: France's New President (1932)
media.evidence: FALLBACK newsreel (no radio found). oEmbed 200, author 'British Pathé' (official channel); description full title: 'France's New President. 61 year-old M. Albert Lebrun - of peasant stock from Lorraine - elected to succeed late M. Paul Doumer.' Exact release date not stated (May 1932).

mediaAlternatives.title: Le Temps
mediaAlternatives.evidence: OAIRecord dc:date 1932-05-12 (Numéro 25827); f1.item title 'Le Temps | 1932-05-12'. ContentSearch page 1: 'Majorité absolue 389 Ont obtenu MM. ALBERT LEBRUN 633 suffrages' (OCR 'C33'); page 2: 'Lebrun est donc élu par le consentement de tous les partis'. (Le Temps is an evening paper dated the following day; the issue dated 11 May, bpt6k248779j, went to press before the vote.)
